rework_history: Promotion review initially trusted a caller-supplied independence boolean instead of crate-controlled authority.
Retirement review initially trusted caller-supplied independence and destructive-effect booleans.
Replacement evidence initially accepted caller-supplied proof-shaped hashes and reviewer identity.
Final retirement initially dropped the originating replacement ledger instead of revalidating it atomically.
Opaque promotion and retirement authorities initially exposed proof-shaped fields through Debug.
Migration plans and retirement targets initially serialized or cloned consumed replacement authority.
The corrected kernel uses opaque one-shot authorities, a persistent exact replacement ledger, bounded redaction, safe projections, and atomic one-winner reconciliation.
closed_findings: Promotion and retirement decisions require opaque independently issued authority instead of caller assertions.
Replacement equivalence remains bound to exact root-observed evidence and its originating live ledger.
Consumed authority cannot be cloned serialized deserialized reconstructed from projections or echoed through Debug.
Final reconciliation revalidates exact candidate catalog inventory session review and destructive-effect authority and elects one atomic winner.
Evaluation records bind immutable specs audits provenance contamination controls observed execution failure harvesting and promotion reconciliation.

root_acceptance_limit: Production-compiled source-local evaluation, promotion, migration, review, and retirement-decision authority with opaque one-shot evidence and atomic reconciliation.
explicitly_withheld: representative live evaluation promotion migration or retirement journeys
invalidation_rule: Any change to an accepted evaluation or migration artifact, its task envelope, WorkerResult, public wiring, fixture, named test harness, authority schema, or dependency binding immediately reopens this acceptance.
no_claim_statement: This acceptance does not claim adapters, durable ledgers, commands, migration adoption, effects, representative journeys, claim elevation, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion.
